name: Autodesk Construction Cloud
positioning: Construction management anchored to the model — because the drawings came out of Revit in the first place.
description: Autodesk Construction Cloud brings together BIM 360, PlanGrid and Assemble into one platform spanning design collaboration, model coordination, field execution, quality, cost management and closeout, tightly coupled to Autodesk's design tools.
real_estate_use: On a project designed in Revit, the coordination advantage is structural: clash detection runs on the federated model, the field team opens the same model on a tablet, and issues raised on site are pinned to model elements rather than to a PDF coordinate. For an owner it makes the digital twin at handover a by-product rather than a separate exercise.
features: Design collaboration and federated model coordination
Clash detection and issue management pinned to model elements
Field execution with drawings, checklists and punch lists offline
Cost management with budgets, contracts and change orders
Handover packages and asset data for operations

use_cases.job: Coordinate design disciplines and resolve clashes before they reach the site
Receive structured asset data at handover instead of a box of PDFs
